name: Animal Disease, Veterinary Care, Herd Genetics & Selective Breeding Runtime
design_rules: disease transmission depends on disease vector exposure and herd contact
isolation reduces transmission but does not instantly cure infection
veterinary care improves recovery through sanitation water rest and nutrition
animals carry heritable traits for resistance productivity temperament and feed efficiency
offspring traits derive from both parents with bounded variation
selective breeding changes herd characteristics across generations rather than instantly
genetic advantages have tradeoffs and do not create perfect animals
herd health and lineage persist across world days and generations
herd genetics never uses emissive or glow feedback
